The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a piece of equipment which, unlike most other tools, does not degrade with use. It's one of three fishing rods found in-game, any of which is required for [[fishing]]. It is provided by the [[Lighthouse Keeper]], sold as a Tier II item for {{Money|300}}. It cannot be acquired through any other means, such as crafting, nor can it be studied.

Compared to the other fishing rods, this fishing rod is the "all-purpose rod", with decent efficiency, and while it can catch all low-tier and most high-tier fish, one may find that it's not always ideal. However, for the most part, it's much more versatile than the 'Simple', while still having a few advantages over the 'Excellent'.

==See Also==
*{{Item|Simple fishing rod}} - the Tier I rod, serving as the quintessential "starter" rod.
*{{Item|Excellent fishing rod}} - the Tier III rod, specifically designed for higher-tier fish.
